column2: ENGLISH

Your challenge has been issued and so it echoes across the plains: You will organise a great tournament to please Khorne and gain his favour. Any who believes they are worthy of the gaze of the Skull God will gather and you will fight all night and bleed and kill until only one remains to bask in the triumph of ultimate victory!
BLOOD FOR THE BLOOD GOD!

I challenge you, scum!
 I call upon you to shed blood in name of Khorne! Meet me and any others who will heed this call at the plains and face my wrath! Only the strongest will survive to bask in the glory of Lord of Skulls!!

 [From.GetTitledFirstName]
I'll rip your heart OUT!!
You're not worthy of my blade.

You miserable worm!
 Ready yourself to depart from this world! Before the next moon, the Bloodletters will feast upon your wretched soul as I claim my rightful place at Khorne's side!

[From.GetTitledFirstName]
Ah!
The boasts of the weak do not concern me. \n Shriek and batter all you want, but that won't make you a worthy adversary to fell with my blade, [From.GetTitledFirstName]
Coward!

Several warriors have answered your call, gathering in the barren plain chosen for the deadly tournament in honour of the Lord of Skulls. Not all are challengers, the word of the great bloodbath caught the attention of many aspiring champions, wanderers, the curious and traders.\n Once you and the other challengers are gathered, all of the other followers surround you, looking towards you in anticipation.\n Above them, the tattered tabards with Khorne's rune blow in a hot wind, their poles already surrounded by little offerings.

Not enough warriors came at your call. The plain lies empty before you, with just some curious cultists roaming around, squabbling over minor quarrels. You've waited for a few days now and it is certain no one else will come.\n It is with great regret that you announce you are forced to cancel the tournament.
BLOOD! BLOOD AND SKULLS!!
This was a waste of time.

Not all are challengers, the word of the great bloodbath caught the attention of many aspiring champions, wanderers, the curious and traders.\n Once you and the other challengers are gathered, all of the other followers surround you, looking towards you in anticipation.\n Above them, the tattered tabards with Khorne's rune blow in a hot wind, their poles already surrounded by little offerings.
BLOOD! BLOOD AND SKULLS!!
As the first challenger, it is only right that you have the honour of starting the deathmatch. Khorne only favours the ruthless and the strong.
Glory to Khorne! Face me!

It is your turn to fight for the glory of Khorne and yourself. You walk towards the centre of the plain, accompanied by the cheering of the cultists sitting and standing in the field around you. [From.GetFirstName], your adversary, comes from the opposite side to meet you in the middle. You roar and beat your weapons on your armour, before charging each other.
DIE!!!

You charge [combatant_2.GetFirstName], smashing [combatant_2.GetHerHis] armor in with a powerful blow and preparing to cut off [combatant_2.GetHerHis] head with your blade as [combatant_2.GetSheHe] lies on the ground, but [combatant_2.GetFirstName] manages to dodge your attack, rolling on the side and tripping you with a kick. Your opponent gets back on [combatant_2.GetHerHis] feet, charging in, waving [combatant_2.GetHerHis] weapon towards you, but you manage to take advantage of [combatant_2.GetHerHis] recklessness and plunge your blade through [combatant_2.GetHerHis] neck.

[combatant_2.GetFirstName] draws the first blood, cutting a long red line on your arm with [combatant_2.GetHerHis] blade and pushing you away with [combatant_2.GetHerHis] shield before you could counterattack. Your opponent licks off the blood from [combatant_2.GetHerHis] weapon and charges again. You clash your blades several times, taunting and grunting, but, when you finally start to tire your arm, you manage to get an opening and cut through [combatant_2.GetHerHis] chest.

You ram into [combatant_2.GetFirstName], raising [combatant_2.GetHerHim] over your head and tossing [combatant_2.GetHerHim] away, then you run to recover your weapon while [combatant_2.GetSheHe] tries to get back on [combatant_2.GetHerHis] feet. \n Your opponent growls something, bashing [combatant_2.GetHerHis] blade on [combatant_2.GetHerHis] shield. When you reach [combatant_2.GetHerHim] [combatant_2.GetSheHe] swings the blade to chop your head off, but you're fast enough to drop on your knees and slice [combatant_2.GetHerHim] from belly to neck.

You exchange swings and blows with your adversary for what seems hours, each of you shouting insults to the other. [combatant_2.GetFirstName] finally manages to break the stall by feinting a thrust and then ramming on you with [combatant_2.GetHerHis] shoulder. You drag [combatant_2.GetHerHim] on the ground as well, starting to punch and bite [combatant_2.GetHerHim], until your teeth finally grab hold of [combatant_2.GetHerHis] neck and tear it open.

You start the duel confident of your abilities, but you soon realize your opponent is tougher than [combatant_2.GetSheHe] appears. [combatant_2.GetFirstName] quickly overcomes you, striking you down, dragging you by the neck for all to see, shouting [combatant_2.GetHerHis] victory.\n Your shame channels anger even more and you finally find the strength to free yourself of [combatant_2.GetHerHis] hold and start choking [combatant_2.GetHerHim]. [combatant_2.GetFirstName] struggles, but it is of no avail to [combatant_2.GetHerHim] and soon falls dead on the ground.

A timely charge allows you to push down your opponent at the start of the duel. You jump on [combatant_2.GetFirstName], painfully crushing [combatant_2.GetHerHis] knees and cutting a gash under [combatant_2.GetHerHis] arm.\n Your opponent screams, but [combatant_2.GetSheHe] will not admit defeat. Rolling on the side, [combatant_2.GetSheHe] throws [combatant_2.GetHerHis] weapon at you, striking you on the shoulder. Limping back on [combatant_2.GetHerHis] uninjured leg, [combatant_2.GetSheHe] tries to tackle you from below, but you're quicker to plunge your blade into [combatant_2.GetHerHis] spine.

Your last strike is so hard, you cut [combatant_2.GetFirstName]'s weapon in half. Shouting your imminent triumph, you advance as [combatant_2.GetSheHe] retreats.\n You need to accuse [combatant_2.GetHerHim] of cowardice several times before [combatant_2.GetSheHe] finally stops running and faces you again.\n Using [combatant_2.GetHerHis] arms to shield [combatant_2.GetHerHim]self, [combatant_2.GetSheHe] throws [combatant_2.GetHerHis]self at you, ignoring your blows, but soon enough you've hacked [combatant_2.GetHerHim] to pieces.

The cheering of the crowd intoxicates you as you strike and kick your opponent on the ground. The duel might end sooner than you thought, [combatant_2.GetFirstName] was easy to disarm and cut down.\n Yet, as you prepare to end [combatant_2.GetHerHis] sufferings, [combatant_2.GetSheHe] rises up suddenly, stopping your blade with [combatant_2.GetHerHis] bare hands and headbutting you. You're almost about to lose grip of your weapon in the commotion, but you manage to hold tight and move forward, making [combatant_2.GetHerHim] impale [combatant_2.GetHerHim]self.

You both lost your weapons during the fight, but that didn't stop you from continuing, grappling and wrestling on the ground.\n [combatant_2.GetFirstName] tries to break your neck, but you pierce [combatant_2.GetHerHis] eye with a nail, breaking [combatant_2.GetHerHis] hold on you. You force [combatant_2.GetHerHim] down, punching repeadetly [combatant_2.GetHerHim] in the head until it's reduced into a bloody pulp.

When [combatant_2.GetFirstName] manages to strike you and draw first blood with a lucky swing, you feel the rage building up inside you. Charging your opponent head-on, you parry [combatant_2.GetHerHis] second strike and trample [combatant_2.GetHerHim]. \n Before [combatant_2.GetSheHe] can get up, you come down on [combatant_2.GetHerHim] starting to bit off pieces of [combatant_2.GetHerHim].\n [combatant_2.GetFirstName] tries to push you back, but it's all for naught and soon you've bled [combatant_2.GetHerHim] dry.

The crowd cheers as you stand over the bloody remains of your defeated opponent, savagely shouting your victory and dedicating the blood tribute to Khorne. Yet, there are more fights to be held, and more challenges for you to be overcome if you wish to truly catch the attention of the Lord of Skulls.
WHO'S NEXT?!

You shout and beat your chest, all covered in steaming blood, surrounded by the dozens of challengers fallen in the quest for glory.\n You never doubted your skill, all this great show of prowess and bloodshed is certain to have endeared Khorne to you. \n The crowd cheers and chants your name, in awe and hidden fear, cowering as you leave the field. Many even start following you, certain that such a strong leader will bring them closer to the Blood God as well.

Your own challenge, your own triumph. You shout and beat your chest, all covered in steaming blood, surrounded by the dozens of challengers fallen in the quest for glory.\n You never doubted your skill, all this great show of prowess and bloodshed is certain to have endeared Khorne to you. \n The crowd cheers and chants your name, in awe and hidden fear, cowering as you leave the field. Many even start following you, certain that such a strong leader will bring them closer to the Blood God as well.
MORE DEATH! MORE BLOOD!!!
[From.GetFirstName] was furious to announce that, due to lack of challengers, the tournament will be cancelled.
All this road for nothing!?!
It's been a long journey, but you're finally back home. A great challenge for Khorne can only be organised every so often. It will be twenty years before another one may be issued...
I'll just kill in some other way!
Khorne favours you! Since you emerged victorious from the ordeal, you can hardly even remember the meaning of fear.
Fear is for cowards and WEAKLINGS!
Surviving the deathmatch made you stronger than you ever were. Khorne must have blessed you!
I'm invincible!
Days have passed since you won the tournament, but it doesn't pass a moment when your mind is not filled with thoughts of blood and violence. The blessing of Khorne filled your heart with rage.
RAAAAAHHHH!!!
You can feel it, more than ever: your victory at the deathmatch did not pass unnoticed in the eyes of the gods. Khorne watches you with approval, new glory awaits you for certain.
BLOOD FOR THE BLOOD GOD!

The Architect of Fate is an unknowable Master. He has taken your offering of blood and trust at the altar of treason, but has repaid you with treason in return. You've killed those that were dear to you, but it'll be all for nothing.
More, I need more sacrifices.

You cut down your friends and family one by one, personally, looking them in the eyes as the treasonous act unravels before them, in their last minute of life. As their blood spills on the altar, drops start flying and flickering beside you and soon an entire army of daemons stands ready at your command.
Power!
What kind of generous gift should you bestow this time upon [From.GetFirstName], so that [From.GetSheHe] may share in Nurgle's magnificence?
The delicate numbing touch of leprosy.
The heart-warming heat of consumption.
The popping joys of the creeping fever.
The great kiss of Nurgle's rot.

You wondered why [From.GetFirstName] was spending so much time with you these past days. Now you know: [From.GetSheHe] was preparing you, unknowing, to receive one of Nurgle's gifts. Dead flesh starts falling off your bones.

You wondered why [From.GetFirstName] was spending so much time with you these past days. Now you know: [From.GetSheHe] was preparing you, unknowing, to receive one of Nurgle's gifts. Blood starts coming out your lungs.

You wondered why [From.GetFirstName] was spending so much time with you these past days. Now you know: [From.GetSheHe] was preparing you, unknowing, to receive one of Nurgle's gifts. Itchy fever-inducing buboes start covering your skin.

You wondered why [From.GetFirstName] was spending so much time with you these past days. Now you know: [From.GetSheHe] was preparing you, unknowing, to receive one of Nurgle's gifts. Your flesh starts rotting and turning into a sickly green hue.
Your entire body is changing shape, strange forms bursting out of your flesh. When you wake, it is clear to you: the Ruinous Powers have bestowed the ultimate gift upon you.
Finally.
Skull-Torc of the Pit
A heavy brass torc strung with the teeth of those who fell in Khorne's blood tournament. The metal is always warm, and on quiet nights it hums for more.
The Everchosen

The End is nigh! Word has come out of the north: a new Everchosen, the anointed champion of all four Ruinous Powers, has risen in the Chaos Wastes, and the tribes of the north are gathering beneath the banner of the eight-pointed star. Whether this Everchosen brings forth the End Times or falls before the stalwart defenders of the world remains to be seen...
[Root.Religion.GetHighGodName], protect us!
FOR CHAOS!
More spiky gitz fer stomping!
Bah, a puppet of the Dark Gods!
Yes-yes, it is time-hour for the Great Ascendancy!
The Everchosen Falls!

Everchosen [Root.GetFirstName] has fallen! Whether by the sword or by treachery, the anointed champion of the Dark Gods is dead, and the great horde is already breaking apart into squabbling warbands. The defenders of Order can rest easy... for now. Chaos has no beginning, and so it has no end.\n\nIn time, another Everchosen will ride out of the Chaos Wastes and once more bring ruin in the name of the Dark Gods.
Victory! Praise the gods!
Weakling! Failure!

[Root.GetTitledFirstName] [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName]! I offer you this one chance to fulfil your destiny and ride with the Host of Chaos Undivided. Kneel, and you will share in the spoils of the world. Refuse, and I will bring you ruin.\n\n[From.GetTitledFirstName], Everchosen of the Dark Gods
Come and get me, coward!
I kneel before the Everchosen.
[From.GetBestName] has spurned your offer and refused [From.GetHerHis] destiny in the service of the Ruinous Powers. [From.GetHerHisCap] suffering will be endless.
I BRING RUIN!
[From.GetBestName] has accepted [From.GetHerHis] destiny and pledged [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName] to the Host of Chaos Undivided. A warbanner of your host now flies over [From.GetHerHis] warriors.
As it should be.
Warbanner of the Everchosen's Host

A tattered standard of flayed hide and blackened iron, bearing the eight-pointed star of Chaos Undivided. The Everchosen sends one to every chieftain who kneels, so that all may know whose host they ride with.

The Everchosen is the champion of all four Chaos Gods, the one mortal behind whom the Ruinous Powers stand united. Far to the north of Naggaroth, beyond the last Druchii watchtowers, the Altar of Ultimate Darkness waits for those who dare to claim the mantle. Many have climbed its steps. Few have come down again.
Lead an army into the province of the Altar of Ultimate Darkness in northern Naggaroth to begin the trials.

You make your way across the wastes, into the northern limits of Naggaroth, where the stories tell of the Altar of Ultimate Darkness. After many trials you reach it at last: a black ziggurat rising out of the ice, its steps slick with the frozen blood of those who came before you.
Ascend the altar and enter the temple!

Upon entering the temple you are beset by nightmarish visions, testing your faith to its very core. Your mind holds, and at last you come to the test: a champion of one of the four gods steps out of the dark. You must defeat [combatant_2.GetHerHim] to earn the mark of the Dark Gods!
I will prove myself worthy - charge!

The body of the first champion has not yet cooled when the shadows stir again. A warrior in black plate, bearing the eight-pointed star of Chaos Undivided, raises [combatant_2.GetHerHis] blade in silent salute. The gods are not yet satisfied.
Deeper in the temple, the walls bleed and whisper. A third champion waits for you here, scarred by a hundred victories and favoured by [combatant_2.GetHerHis] god. One more death, and then another.
